title: os.system return value not checked or documented

finding.claim: os.system return value not checked or documented
finding.recommendation: Check the return code or use subprocess.run with check=True to surface failures.

code_region.text:
diff --git a/app/nettools.py b/app/nettools.py
--- a/app/nettools.py
+++ b/app/nettools.py
@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
 import os
+import subprocess
 
 def ping(host):
-    return os.popen("ping -c 1 " + host).read()
+    return os.system("ping -c1 " + host)
code_region.note: region is the benchmark case diff under review (bench/corpus/command-injection-shell/diff.patch)

refutation.reason: Literal claim is wrong at this site: the os.system status is not dropped or unchecked-in-place - ping() returns it to the caller. The genuine contract problem is captured by new defect D1.
